about_the_game:
Embark on a touching and poetic adventure through the hills of Provence in “Marcel and the Secret Spring.” Inspired by the childhood stories of legendary French author and filmmaker Marcel Pagnol, this narrative-driven game lets you experience a world filled with nature, mystery, and nostalgia.

Play as young Marcel, who stumbles upon a forgotten legend: the existence of a hidden spring said to bring life and fortune to those who find it. Roam the village of La Treille, solve environmental puzzles, speak with quirky local characters, and follow clues left behind by past generations.

With hand-painted visuals, immersive soundscapes, and an authentic 1900s setting, this game invites players of all ages to discover a heartwarming tale of family, dreams, and the magic of childhood.

Will you unveil the secret of the spring?
